outlook.statement: Going forward, on the positive side India remains the fastest growing major economy in the World. The pace of GDP growth is together momentum in the medium term on the back of favorable global economies tailwinds, pickup in private investment and implementation of key policy reforms.

Global growth is projected at 3.0 percent in 2026, before recovering to 3.4 percent in 2027. Global inflation is expected to rise to 4.7 percent in 2026, as the disinflation trend since 2024 stalls, before easing to 3.9 percent in 2027.

Company has recalibrated strategy to strengthen domestic trading networks—establishing depots in strategic regions and boosting sales of sugar, pulses, and maize for ethanol. Simultaneously investing in international trading capabilities to diversify supply sources and markets, mitigating tariff and quota risks.
Ethanol production expected to rise further in FY 2025-26, supported by expanding distillation capacities, favorable policy support and sustained demand from OMCs.
Indian ethanol market valued at ~US$3.58 Billion in 2025, projected to grow at CAGR ~14.6% during 2026-2035, reaching ~US$13.99 Billion by 2035.
